Issue #8281 回复草稿（verl 共享 prompt cap 忽略 data.truncation）

【仓库】 verl（RL 训练框架，issue #8281 / PR #8313）

【贡献点】 共享 prompt cap 遵循 data.truncation 四策略的修复（PR #8313，用户已关闭待 review）+ middle/cap=1 的 -0 边界修复（fork 分支 commit 6db4b38d）+ 本 issue 回复草稿正文。

【类型】 技术回复草稿（对外发布待用户授权）

【价值评估】 7 / 10 — 确认契约问题、说明修复状态与边界补充，向 reporter 提供完整技术答复；发布时机由用户决定。

【进展】 CPU 测试 12 项全过（含 cap=1 回归，对照验证有效）；GPU e2e 冒烟已由 M5 完成（error 策略 fail-loudly）；修复 commit 在 fork 分支 fix-8281-truncation-policy，待用户决定重开 PR。

【大白话讲明白】 verl 对超长 prompt 的截断之前不管配置、一律只留尾部；现在改为按 data.truncation 四策略处理（默认 error 直接报错）。审查中发现 middle 策略在「上限=1」的极端情况下会因 Python 的 -0 陷阱把 10 个 token 变成 11 个，已一并修复并补测试。

【What–Why–How】

  • What： 共享 prompt cap 遵循 data.truncation 四策略的修复（PR #8313）+ middle/cap=1 边界修复 + 本 issue 技术回复草稿。
  • Why： reporter 将 #8281 定位为「共享 cap 契约讨论」，修复点在单一共享路径 _cap_text_prompt_length（覆盖 SingleTurn/ToolAgent 所有 CT 构建 loop），比旧 PR #4600 更贴合当前架构；边界修复避免方法在 cap=1 时违反上限。
  • How： 回复确认复现与修复状态、说明 middle/cap=1 反例与修复、提出 error 训练器行为契约问题供维护者对齐；发布前需用户授权（铁律：不在主仓库行动）。

定位：技术确认 + 修复进展 + 诚实的边界补充。发不发、何时发由用户决定。

Thanks for the detailed write-up — I can confirm the contract issue and summarize the current fix state, plus one boundary case we found while reviewing it.

1. Fix status: data.truncation is now honored in _cap_text_prompt_length

A fix for the shared cap is in PR #8313 (closed pending review; the branch will be reopened once approved). It makes _cap_text_prompt_length honor the documented data.truncation policy:

  • error (default): fail loudly instead of silently left-truncating;
  • left / right / middle: truncate with a warning as documented.

CPU unit tests (12, including the new cap-1 regression below) pass; an e2e GPU smoke run also passed with the default error path fail-loudly under an overlong prompt.

2. Boundary case found during review: middle at cap=1

While reviewing the middle branch we found an edge case worth fixing before merge:

head = (prompt_length + 1) // 2
return prompt_ids[:head] + prompt_ids[-(prompt_length - head):]

When prompt_length == 1, head = 1 and the tail budget is 0. In Python -0 == 0, so prompt_ids[-0:] selects the entire list instead of an empty tail — a 10-token prompt is returned as 11 tokens, violating the cap. left/right handle cap=1 correctly; middle was the only affected branch, and the original test parametrization only covered caps 4/5/6.

The follow-up patch replaces the negative tail slice with a forward slice prompt_ids[len(prompt_ids) - tail_length:] (naturally empty when the budget is 0) and adds a regression test. This is included in the same PR branch.

3. Contract question

Your framing — that this is a shared-cap contract decision rather than a per-loop truncation — matches where the fix lands: _cap_text_prompt_length is the single shared path used by both SingleTurnAgentLoop and ToolAgentLoop (and any other CT-built loop), which is why fixing it there covers more than the earlier #4600 approach (pre-refactor, dirty against current main).

One thing worth confirming with maintainers: the error-raises behavior in the trainer path — i.e. whether a rollout worker crashing on an overlong prompt should abort the step or be surfaced differently. Happy to align the implementation with whatever the project prefers.
